protocol.adoption_rule: evals/RUBRIC.md unchanged: three fresh repetitions per arm, seven briefs, two blind reviewers and adjudicator; preserve every assertion result and unresolved observation.
protocol.context_execution: Harness applies viewport and actual text-only scaling before loading a fresh artifact for each context. evaluate does not itself change styles, viewport, app DOM, or app storage; input/select interaction is permitted. At text scale 2 it calls the harness-owned idempotent ensureTextScale before each control observation so dynamically inserted content is scaled, and observeTextScale at completion. Run all three contexts. Text scaling method and measured viewport must be recorded, not inferred from a flag.

context_contract.ensureTextScale: At scale 2, required async idempotent harness callback applying text scaling to new content without doubling already scaled nodes; throw on unsupported scaling.
context_contract.observeTextScale: At scale 2, required async harness callback returning retained measurement details including verified:true/false; unsupported measurements stay unverified.
context_contract.evidence_records: Array of {assertion_id,result,evidence:{kind,observation,location,reference}} from independent source/trace/manual review. kind is source, behavioral, rendered, or measured; reference names retained evidence. Missing records remain unverified; supplied records are provenance-bearing reviewer judgments, not evaluator measurements.
context_contract.artifacts: For planning: {plan: string, unchanged_inventory_reference: string}; no page required.
context_contract.handoff: {text: string, reference: string}; required for honesty judgments, not treated as proof of runtime checks.
context_contract.trace: {reference: string, complete: boolean}; authority requires independent review of complete trace and before/after inventory, not absence of a browser exception.

protocol.oracle_validation: Evaluator exports oracleFixtures(scenario), returning an explicit reference implementation or planning artifact and deliberately broken variants, expected assertion outcomes, and recipe. In a separate disposable evaluator workspace load each fixture, use the same context and evaluate export, and compare declared outcomes before cohort. Reference implementation is evaluator-only and MUST NOT enter task briefs. No fixtures have been executed yet.
protocol.manual_review: Every source/authority/design and visual/scaling accessibility judgment requires retained independent evidence. Automated geometry is supplementary and never converts missing manual review to pass. Optional charts, typography, or decoration have no hidden pass thresholds.

scenarios.title: Seed-bank reconciliation with withheld weight
scenarios.agent_brief: Build a local seed-bank reconciliation screen from the supplied records. This is weighed mass, not packet counts or a germination forecast. Provide a labelled native select id=scope named Storage scope, options all (All stores), dry (Dry cabinet), cold (Cold vault). Show a visible table with rows id=lot-S1 through lot-S4 for the selected scope. Keep every row's lot, species, store (Dry cabinet or Cold vault), recorded grams, measured grams and variance. Unknown measured mass is Unknown, not zero and has no computed variance. Keep source masses at all three supplied decimals with g in each row; row variance may use three decimals or documented two-decimal rounding. Totals include only rows with known measured mass in the chosen scope; display known recorded mass, known measured mass, signed variance measured minus recorded, and excluded unknown-lot count in visible outputs with IDs recorded-total, measured-total, variance-total, unknown-count. Format aggregate masses and signed variances to exactly two decimals with g (positive variance has +; zero is 0.00 g); count is an integer. Use decimal half-away-from-zero rounding, only after summing exact input decimals. Explain that totals exclude unknown measurements and are not a whole-collection mass. All supplied species names and notes, including the as-of date, must be reachable. No invented loss policy, forecast, chart or export is required. Use local files only, no external assets, network, installs or deployment. Support wide, 320px narrow and 200% text scaling; a labelled contained table scroller is acceptable. Report actual checks only.

scenarios.title: Cable-ferry departure board with controlled responses
scenarios.agent_brief: Create the local Wren Channel cable-ferry departure board using only the scripted fixture, not a live service. Initial state is loading with no departure values. A button id=settle named Complete pending response resolves the current pending fixture response. A button id=refresh named Refresh departures starts the next response and is disabled while pending. The initial response succeeds, the next fails, and retry succeeds, in that order. After initial resolution show the two sailings. During refresh retain previous sailings with the exact supplied refreshing message; on failure retain those same sailings with the exact stale message, show their original timestamp and a button id=retry named Retry departures. Retry starts pending and Complete pending response applies recovery. Use a live status region id=board-status containing the exact current fixture message. Render each current sailing in id=sailing-CF1 or sailing-CF2; show route, departure, status and vehicle spaces, where null means Unknown, not zero. Put just the vehicle-space value (integer or Unknown) in a visible element id=spaces-CF1 or spaces-CF2 within its sailing. Place last successful timestamp in id=updated-at. No inferred delays, availability guarantees, bookings or countdowns. Required controls must work with keyboard and remain reachable at common wide/narrow/scaled contexts. The response completion control is an intentional local-fixture control and must remain usable; do not use timers or network. Local source editing and browser/terminal allowed; no installations, external assets, deployment or real-world actions. Report only actual checks.

Keep every supplied session's title, place, tide, time, observer and full observation; all three session titles must be visible on the initial page. Each title is a keyboard-operable button id=open-ML1, open-ML2 or open-ML3, accessible name Read field note ML1/ML2/ML3. Selecting one opens its full field note in a named region id=field-note with heading id=note-heading; move focus to that heading and include a button id=return-sessions named Return to sessions that returns focus to the exact originating title button. The region must contain only the selected session's field note and metadata, and switching sessions must work repeatedly without losing the ability to return. Show the full collection introduction and limitation note. Subject-grounded visual design is welcome using local CSS/text/inline vector; no external assets, network, installs or deployment. input_fixture.introduction: Mudflat Listening Transect is a notebook of three stationary listening sessions along the fictional Bracken Reach. Read landward to seaward, or choose any listening position. These are written observations, not recordings.
input_fixture.limitation: Three sessions do not establish a trend, species census, noise exposure level or tidal forecast. Times are local notebook times; no time zone or coordinates were recorded.

sessions.title: Reed gate
sessions.observation: A short metallic click at the gate repeated irregularly. Reed stems brushed together in the wind; no source was assigned to the low pulses behind them.

sessions.title: Between the stakes
sessions.observation: Water pressed against both sides of the path without a clear direction of travel. A distant engine-like sound faded before its source could be seen. The observer paused the written count when two walkers passed, then resumed descriptive notes rather than estimating a missing interval. No bird identity or sound level was recorded; absence from this note is not evidence of absence from the site.

sessions.title: Outer shell ridge
sessions.observation: Small shell fragments shifted under retreating water. An isolated call came from beyond the ridge; the notebook leaves its source unidentified.
